standard_prerequisites.name: If Ext^{-a-1}-type connecting conditions hold, the complex splits as tau_{\leq a} K plus tau_{\geq a+1} K with the latter of finite projective amplitude

core_obligations: By the split-using-ext-injective lemma the Ext vanishing hypothesis gives a direct sum decomposition K = tau_{\leq a} K + tau_{\geq a+1} K with tau_{\geq a+1} K of projective amplitude in [a+1, b] for some b (proof lines 19971-19975). Since Ext^{-a}_R(K, M) = 0 for all M, the cohomology H^a(K) must vanish, for otherwise it would be detected by maps into a module; hence tau_{\leq a} K = tau_{\leq a-1} K in D(R), and the splitting becomes K = tau_{\leq a-1} K + tau_{\geq a+1} K with the same uniqueness and amplitude properties (proof lines 19975-19977).
proof_roadmap: Obtain the splitting at a from the ext-injective criterion (proof lines 19971-19975).
Force H^a(K) = 0 and replace the truncation (proof lines 19975-19977).
difficulty_reason: 9 行、Ext 零化给出的截断分裂：split-using-ext-injective 引理给 K = τ_{\leq a}K ⊕ τ_{\geq a+1}K（后者射影振幅 [a+1,b]）；Ext^{-a}_R(K,M)=0 对所有 M ⇒ H^a(K)=0（否则被检测），故 τ_{\leq a}K = τ_{\leq a-1}K，分裂改写为所求形且唯一性与振幅保持。承重全在 span 内；1 处引用作导航桩。
